increment: Front B B0: optical observatory static evidence pack (Set Coordinates, hot list, Add Current Item, date/time, site, Limit Slewing, spectrometer Save/Print confirmation)
method: Static only: GNU objdump (Intel syntax, no raw bytes in listings), a Python reader of Delphi AnsiString/PChar/ShortString literals and x87 constants, a Delphi 7 VMT/RTTI reader, and the typed DFM decoder. No execution, emulation, or byte dumps in the repository. Hashes below were computed by the B0 author over the evidence files.
hashPolicy: sha256 of each evidence file as written in evidenceRoot (also listed in SHA256SUMS.txt there).

contracts.claim: Slew > Set Coordinates... (SetCoordinates1, OnClick CoordBtnClick) uses the single shared TSkyCoordsDlg instance [0x5b5e0c] (DFM caption ' Enter Sky Coordinates for Slew'). When no programmed slew is running (+0x64d = 0): if both target globals (RA cell [0x5b5e20], Dec cell [0x5b5604]) are exactly 0.0 they are prefilled with the current pointing (+0x65f RA h, +0x669 Dec deg); EpochGrp (+0x3a0) is ENABLED; ShowModal; ModalResult = 1 calls ProgrammedSlew.
contracts.uncertainty: Field validation/precession inside TSkyCoordsDlg is the already-ported radio contract (RA-09, RA-EP-01..04); not re-derived here.

contracts.claim: Set Coordinates while a programmed slew is running (+0x64d ≠ 0): SlewTimer2 is disabled and a Yes/No question (MB_YESNO|MB_ICONQUESTION 0x24) is shown. Yes (6): slew terminated (axis-done flags +0x5e8/+0x5ea/+0x5ec := 1, motor sound stop, N/S/E/W buttons re-enabled, previous rate restored, +0x64d := 0); No: SlewTimer2 re-enabled (slew resumes). The coordinates dialog is not opened in either case.
contracts.uncertainty: Sound/motor helpers 0x540480 and 0x53a40c named by effect only.

contracts.claim: ProgrammedSlew Test Mode branch: when env+0x2e7c ≠ 0 (TOptionsDlg TestBox1 "Test Mode" -> record+0x27c8, compiled default 0) the no-slew check, horizon check and confirmation are all skipped and the telescope jumps instantly to the target (pointing := globals, finder/instrument re-projected, flags set done).

contracts.claim: Ordinal hot-list row formatter, cleanly recovered: s := IntToStr(ordinal); while Length(s) < 4 do Insert(' ', s, 1) (left-pad to width 4); result := s + RA + Dec, with RA = 0x486ca0(rec+0x19, digits 2, 'h ', 'm ', 's ') and Dec = 0x486ca0(rec+0x23, digits 1, '° ', "' ", '"  '). No ID and no remarks. RA/Dec fields are exactly formatHotListRa/formatHotListDec of src/core/radioHotListFormat.ts, so row = String(n).padStart(4,' ') + formatHotListRa(ra) + formatHotListDec(dec) (ordinals ≥ 10000 are not padded/truncated).
contracts.uncertainty: Delphi Insert (0x4063b0) identified by its (Source, var S, Index=1) call shape; IntToStr 0x40ac14. Same 0x486ca0 caveats as the radio port.

contracts.claim: Slew > Observation Hot List > Add Current Item/Position to List... (0x53f0fc): 0x53cf94 identifies the catalogue object under the current pointing (0x53ce8c, pixel lookup 0x59a0fc at the projected finder position; nil when none). The dialog [0x5b5b10] is bound to THOVerifyDlg (CreateForm class cell 0x4f8400 -> VMT 0x4f844c at 0x5ad493..0x5ad4a1). Prefill record (dlg+0x3b0, 86 bytes): ID ShortString[24] := object name (or empty when no object); remarks ShortString[40] := "" , but when exercise byte env+0x383f = 0 and an object exists, remarks := its kind: 0 "Star", 1 "Galaxy", 2 "Asteroid", 3 "QSO"; RA := current +0x65f, Dec := current +0x669.
contracts.uncertainty: The object lookup 0x59a0fc (which pixel/tolerance) is not decoded; port as "object at the reticle when the existing identification finds one".

contracts.claim: THOVerifyDlg.OKBtnClick 0x4f8898: RA := StrToFloat(h) + StrToFloat(m)/60 + StrToFloat(s)/3600; any conversion exception or RA < 0 or RA > 24 -> MessageDlg(mtError, [mbOK]) and ModalResult := 0. Dec: sign := −1 if StrToFloat(deg) < 0 else +1 (so "-0" is positive); Dec := deg + sign*min/60 + sign*sec/3600; exception or Dec < −90 or > 90 -> MessageDlg and ModalResult := 0. Success: ID := IDEd truncated to 24, RA, Dec, remarks := CmntEd1 truncated to 40, ModalResult := 1.
contracts.uncertainty: Bounds are inclusive (24.0 h and ±90° accepted). Hints ('0-23', '+89 - -89') are not enforced. IDEd MaxLength 16 vs ShortString[24] vs hint 12: keep all three facts.

contracts.claim: After OK (ModalResult 1): 0x590588 appends the record to the hot-list linked list (+0x58d, 0x492728), marks it modified (+0x587 := 0), enables THotListForm1.SaveList1 and the observatory menu SaveUpdatedList1 ([0x5b5880]+0x490; radio form in exercise 6). contracts.claim: TStationDlg.OKBtnClick 0x592908, in order: name := LocEd (ShortString[40]); UT−local := StrToFloat(UtLtEd) (Single), height := StrToFloat(AltEd) (Single), horizon := StrToFloat(HorzEd)*π/180; conversion exception or |UT−local| > 12 -> MB_ICONSTOP box, ModalResult := 0 (name/UT/height/horizon already written to the buffer). Longitude := d + m/60 + s/3600, invalid if exception or < 0 or > 180; West (EWGrp ItemIndex 1) negates. Latitude same with 0..90, South negates. Each failure -> box, ModalResult := 0. Success stores lon/lat radians. No DST handling.
